reading_scope: Current official documentation; pinned SUMO1.26 source must separately establish implementation
paraphrase: Automatically generated yellow duration depends on incoming road maximum speed and is configurable.
A yellow signal makes approaching vehicles decelerate if sufficiently far from the junction; otherwise they may pass.
setPhase may select transition phases while native logic handles yellow/red progression.
setPhaseDuration changes remaining duration of the current occurrence, not future occurrences.
